intent: Stack a message's header, visible surface and footer in one column beside the avatar.
typical_uses: The column holding a Bubble, optionally with a MessageHeader above it and a MessageFooter below it

dont_use_when.situation: The visible surface of the message, its fill, frame and text

invariants.text: The column fills the rest of the row, stacks its children in source order var(--space-3) apart and wraps long unbroken words (`overflow-wrap: break-word`), so header, surface and footer appear in the order they are written.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the message text directly inside MessageContent
anti_patterns.do_instead: Wrap it in a Bubble with a BubbleContent, which draws the surface the text sits on

good.title: Header, surface and footer in one column

bad.title: The message text with no surface around it
bad.why: MessageContent draws no fill, frame or padding of its own; the text renders bare beside the avatar, and only a Bubble gives it the message surface.
